nodes.long_description:
# Ask Around - Ai Assistant

**Meet the AI that sees what you see.**

Imagine having an intelligent AI companion right inside your Meta Quest — one that can help you understand the world around you, answer your questions, and guide you through real-world challenges.

Meet Ask Around, your personal AI assistant powered by advanced artificial intelligence and designed to bring AI understanding into your view of the world.

## See It. Ask About It. Understand It.

With Ask Around, you can ask questions about the objects, scenes, and situations around you.

Wondering what something is? Need help understanding how something works? Looking at a problem and not sure where to start?

Simply ask your AI companion.

Ask Around combines visual understanding and natural voice interaction to help you explore, learn, and find answers based on what you're looking at.

## Your AI Companion for the Real World

Ask Around can help you:

- **Understand Your Surroundings:** Ask about objects, environments, and things you encounter in everyday life.
- **Explore the Unknown:** Discover what unfamiliar objects are, how things work, and what you might be looking at.
- **Get Help with Real-World Problems:** Describe a situation and ask for possible explanations, troubleshooting steps, or practical guidance.
- **Ask Follow-Up Questions:** Keep the conversation going, explore different possibilities, and dive deeper into a topic.
- **Talk Naturally:** Interact with your AI assistant using your voice in a natural, conversational way.

nodes.change_log:
What's New

• 12 brand-new AI Roommate avatars — pick your favorite in the
  AI Roommate tab.

• Avatar calls got a major upgrade: smoother talking, no more
  the avatar repeating itself, and no more crashes mid-call.

• Pop-up screens are fixed — taps no longer go through to the
  buttons behind them.

• Clearer subscription and paywall screens.

• Bug fixes and performance improvements throughout the app.

Thanks for being an AskAround user — enjoy the update!

New: Profile page in the sidebar — sign out or permanently delete your account and all stored data (conversations, generated images, history) with one confirmation. Also adds per-image and per-conversation delete controls.

"What's new in this release:
 Improved AI response quality and conversation handling.\n• Enhanced camera-based assistance for understanding objects and surroundings.
 Improved voice interaction for a smoother hands-free experience. Refined AI provider connectivity and request handling.
 Improved app stability, loading performance, and error handling. Fixed minor bugs and polished the overall user experience.
Thank you for choosing AskAround – Your AI Personal Assistant!"

Welcome to AskAround — your AI personal assistant that sees what you see.

Ever looked at something and wondered, “What is this?”  
Ever faced a problem at home and wished someone could guide you through it?  
Ever needed a little help figuring out how something works?

Now, you can simply ask.

Meet AskAround, your AI companion designed to help you understand the world around you. Using visual AI understanding and natural voice interaction, AskAround brings your surroundings into the conversation — so you can ask questions, explore possibilities, and get helpful guidance based on what you're looking at.

### � Facing a problem at home?
A crack in the wall? A leaking pipe? A strange electrical issue? Something that just doesn't look right?

Show AskAround what you're seeing, describe the situation, and ask for help understanding possible causes, what to check, and where to start.

Whether you're a homeowner, a DIY enthusiast, or simply someone trying to figure things out, AskAround can help make complicated situations easier to understand.

### � Working on a repair or DIY project?
Trying to fix something, assemble furniture, understand a tool, or figure out how a device works?

AskAround can help you explore the object in front of you, understand its purpose, and get step-by-step guidance for your next move.

No need to know all the technical terms. Just ask naturally.

### � Are you a professional or a tradesperson?
Whether you're an interior finishing specialist, technician, electrician, plumber, or someone working with tools and materials, AskAround can be a helpful companion on the job.

Use it to explore unfamiliar materials, understand visible details, discuss possible solutions, and get another perspective when facing a challenging situation.

It's not about replacing your experience — it's about giving you another way to think, investigate, and find answers.

### � Curious about the world around you?
See something unfamiliar? Wondering what an object is, how it works, or what it's used for?

Simply look at it and ask.

From everyday objects to unfamiliar environments, AskAround helps turn curiosity into understanding.

### � A conversation that feels natural
Ask a question using your voice, get an answer, and keep the conversation going.

Ask follow-up questions. Explore different possibilities. Get more details when you need them.

Your view provides the context. Your questions guide the conversation.

### � Your world. Your questions. Your AI.
AskAround is built for curiosity, discovery, practical guidance, and everyday problem-solving.

Whether you're learning something new, working on a project, fixing something at home, or simply wondering about the world around you, your AI companion is ready to help you explore.

**See the world. Ask anything. Get answers.**

Welcome to AskAround.

*Important: AskAround provides AI-generated information that may not always be accurate. It is intended to support understanding and exploration, not replace qualified professional advice. Always use your own judgment. For electrical, structural, plumbing, medical, or other potentially hazardous situations, consult a qualified professional before taking action.*
